C1679.title: Hades PyPI Attack: 19 Packages Poisoned to Auto-Run Bun Credential Stealer
C1679.summary: In June 2026, a malicious campaign dubbed Hades uploaded 19 poisoned packages to PyPI. These packages contained a credential stealer and could abuse developers' OIDC trust configurations to push trojanized versions of PyPI packages onto compromised systems, enabling lateral spread.
